title: eludite.project.new input
description: Create a project from a template (File > New Project..., Ctrl+Shift+N; brief 0072). eludite-host runs `dotnet new <template> --name <name> --output <location>/<name>` (out of process; the output goes to the Output window's Templates source), creating a solution first when `solution` is new and adding the project to it, or to the workspace's solution when `solution` is add (`dotnet sln add`). Then, unless `open` is false, the workspace opens (the new solution's folder; with add, the workspace refreshes) and the project's main file opens. From the UI without arguments it shows the New Project dialog.

template.description: A template's identity or short name, from eludite.project.templates (console, classlib, webapi, xunit, ...).

location.description: Absolute folder the project's folder is created in. Default: the workspace folder.

language.description: C#, F# or VB, for a template offered in several (default: C#).

solution.description: new: create `<location>/<solution_name>.slnx` and add the project to it; add: add it to the workspace's solution (a .sln or .slnx; with no solution open this is new); none: no solution. Default: add when the workspace has a solution, else new.

solution_name.description: The new solution's name (default: the project's name).

framework.description: The target framework (`--framework`, such as net10.0) when the template has the parameter.

parameters.description: Other template parameters by name (as eludite.project.templates lists them), as strings (`true`/`false` for bool).

open.description: Open the result in the workspace (default true).
